subject: If conditions remain acceptable through arrival and warming then occurs during a documented receiving delay, that pattern would weaken explanations confined to earlier stages.
rationale: Under the stated temporal-resolution, sensor-placement and measurement-comparability conditions, warming localized after arrival would count against explanations confined to earlier stages in the monitored case. This licenses weakening, without eliminating earlier contributions, excluding combined mechanisms or proving that the delay caused warming. The relation remains hypothetical and establishes neither an observed outcome nor food-safety status.
